newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes four cents down at 14.52 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes four cents down at 14.52 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell four cents to 14.52 ringgit ($5.75) a kg, as players tried to ease a widening premium against the London Metal Exchange (LME) and square positions ahead of the new year, traders said.
"There were more sellers because the premium in the last few days was very high," said a trader. "Also, players are balancing books ahead of the year-end."
Offers outnumbered bids by 59 tonnes to 38. Turnover was 44 tonnes against 97 on Thursday. The local premium against London narrowed to $65 a tonne from $100 previously, traders said.
